definition: A closure label is attached to a coarse or naive channel. A finer channel already inside the same likelihood stays open. The closure is false. If the finer channel is also closed, the closure was true and FSC does not fire.
not_this: Not RGC: RGC is the derivative where the unnamed channel outruns the named one and nobody is required to have declared the census closed.
Not RSC: RSC is every corner of one same-kind rectangle missing one residual.
Not DPC: DPC is a construct denominator treated as observed.
Not the rediscovery of open versus closed pangenomes (Tettelin).
Not PhyloThin. That method belongs to Götsch and Baumdicker.
Not Kind-Substitution. Queued from RSC-2026-10-11. Not minted here.
alpha_equation_threshold: NOT_RETRIEVED. Scorer uses the preprint's closed/open words. It does not apply Prasoodanan α ≤ 0 and does not assume α > 1 means closed.

kill: If the effective channel for Akkermansia is also closed under the preprint's own definition, or the quoted alphas are not in the PDF, this instance dies. If a later census shows the naive closed label and the effective open label were different species or different datasets, same_likelihood fails and the instance dies. FSC as a test can be reused.
